decisions.reason: The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the publicly communicated backbone of the integrated identity offer, so despite its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 management will treat it as embedded in the platform rather than abandon it.

With the encrypted secondary channel it extended already withdrawn and no visibility since 2019, the email-to-app robot has lost the strategic anchor that justified persistence, and its weak results can no longer credibly be blamed on temporary causes.

The payment security compliance suite ties directly to the regulatory positioning the firm has announced, and management can still attribute its low visibility to drawn-out PSD2 and strong customer authentication adoption cycles, so it persists with the product.
